invariants.text: Product.id must be an auto-incremented integer primary key with default value None
The SKU of a product must be unique across all products in the inventory.
The stock quantity of a product must be non-negative.
The price of a product must be non-negative.
When a product is deleted, its associated stock quantity is removed from the inventory.
When a product is updated, the new stock quantity must not exceed the maximum allowable stock quantity defined by inventory policy.
A product search must return only products that match the specified name or category filter.
A category filter must return all products that belong to the specified category.
Low-stock reporting must identify products with a stock quantity less than or equal to 10.
The total number of products in the inventory must remain consistent across all CRUD operations.
When a product is added, its SKU must not already exist in the inventory.
